job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Create and refine prompts that guide gen AI models to produce accurate and relevant outputs. Ensure prompts align with project objectives and user needs.
Work with data scientists and AI developers to fine-tune model parameters based on prompt effectiveness. Implement strategies to improve model responses.
Conduct experiments to assess the performance of different prompts. Analyze results to identify areas for improvement and implement changes accordingly.
Experience in OpenAI Playground, Prompt Engineering Libraries, Custom Fine-tuning Services
Familiarity with natural language processing (NLP) tools
Experience in ML, Data Science basic and advance techniques



Preferred candidate profile

Experience in development and deployment of GenAI solution
Analytics and AI tooling Sagemaker, GenAI
Orchestration Airflow, Step Functions, Ctrl M etc
Languages and scripting: Python, SQL
Cloud Services - AWS, GCP, Azure and Cloud Native [Any one cloud service is mandatory]
Ensure GenAI outputs are contextually relevant,
Collaborate with service line teams to design, implement and manage Gen-AI solution
undefined
Preferred Qualifications/ Skills
AI and GenAI Tools Certifications in AI/ML or GenAI (optional)Experience in generative models, prompt engineering, and fine-tuning techniques to develop innovative AI solutions. Designing, developing, and implementing solutions tailored to meet client needs. Understanding business requirements and translating them into technical solutions using GEN AI
